signal: Neuron7 raised $44M Series B, grew ARR 300% in the last year, and unveiled a full Service Intelligence Stack in April 2026

email.body1:
JT, saw Neuron7 raised its $44M Series B, grew ARR 300% last year, and just unveiled the full Service Intelligence Stack.

Growth that fast usually means more enterprise accounts in play than the team can cover before new reps ramp, and that is where deals go cold. Our AI SDR researches, writes, and follows up autonomously, so coverage scales without new headcount: 3-5x more meetings per rep.

I built a personalized signal play for Neuron7 off your hiring and tech-stack signals, and accounts showing them tend to progress about 4.4x faster. Worth 15 minutes for me to walk you through it?
email.body2:
JT, quick follow-up for Neuron7.

Post-Series-B, board expectations on pipeline usually jump faster than headcount can. Most teams don't actually know how many meetings they need to hit the new number, so the gap shows up late and the quarter becomes a scramble to recover.

Want to grab 15 minutes? I'll walk you through our pipeline model and show exactly how many meetings Neuron7 needs to close that gap this quarter, and where the math breaks if you only add reps.
email.body3:
JT, last bit of proof for Neuron7.

Memgraph had more in-market accounts than the team could touch and couldn't hire SDRs fast enough. They ran our AI SDR to $2.7M in pipeline, 600 replies, and 60 BANT-qualified deals in 90 days, same team, live in four weeks, every email auto-logged to their CRM.

I pulled a benchmark of how Neuron7's reply rate likely compares to other Series-B startups. Want to hop on a quick call and I'll walk you through it?
email.body4:
JT, I'll stop reaching out on this one, but didn't want to leave you empty-handed.

If scaling pipeline without adding headcount isn't a priority for Neuron7 this quarter, no problem at all. Timing is everything right after a raise, and I know the fundraise-to-hiring stretch is its own kind of busy.

Before I close your file, worth 15 minutes to walk through a one-page playbook of three AI-SDR plays scoped to a Series-B motion? I'll tailor it to Neuron7 either way.
